data.one_liner: Port of .NET LINQ and MoreLINQ functional enumerable extension methods to Dart.
data.what_it_does: Extends native Dart Iterables with over 110 functional programming methods like select, distinct, groupBy, and more. Also provides custom tuple classes up to Tuple9 and utility iterables.
use_when: You want to use .NET-style LINQ and MoreLINQ query operators on Dart Iterables.
You need type-safe immutable tuples ranging from Tuple0 to Tuple9.
You want lazy-evaluated data transformations and extensions.
avoid_when: You only need basic built-in Dart collection methods like map, where, and expand.
You are looking for state management or complex UI layout tools.
strengths: Massive collection of powerful extension methods for Iterables.
Includes serialization-ready immutable tuples and Dart 3 record deconstruction support.
weaknesses: Adds a large surface area of extension methods which might clutter auto-completions.
data.minimal_example:
var list = [10, 20, 30];
var mappedList = list.select((i, index) => '$index-$i'); // ['1-10', '2-20', '3-30']
